trigger: The independently computed transparent Observation passed all four FACTOR_FIT gates but failed the one-shot unseen-surface confirmation specificity floor. Owner/time, boundary, and increment predictions defaulted ON; only goal/function generalized reliably.

scope_boundary.step1_role: learn expected component marginal utility after eligibility and qualified execution
scope_boundary.step2_role: bind and apply only resources requested by the selected feasible action
scope_boundary.generator_role: produce the response under the realized action without inventing or upgrading memory evidence

time_and_version_validity.source: candidate timestamps, supersedes links, active or withdrawn status, and current session time

component_presence.source: actual Rank-1 candidate and retriever qualification record
component_presence.operation: absent or disqualified candidate forces component OFF

goal_function_fit.evidence: one-shot confirmation balanced accuracy 0.96 with specificity 1.0

decision_rule: A component may reach Step1 only if structured owner/time/presence gates pass and every bounded semantic factor is positive. Any negative or unknown factor forces that component OFF before Step1.

validation_and_stop_rule.next_evidence: new versioned system-level qualification using backend metadata plus bounded semantic decisions, followed by the already planned H-Step2 and effect data only if it passes
validation_and_stop_rule.failure_means: report Observation coverage limitation; do not attribute the failure to Step1, Step2, retrieval, or generator
